pr_title: Externalise autoplay generation from `Player` to allow use of replay playback functions
pr_body:
Closes #12653.

Note that there are test failures as a result of this change. I'm PRing to get feedback on whether this is the correct direction before putting in the effort to fix tests (definitely non-trivial in this case).
pr_comments: I've pushed the simple solution anyways. See if you agree or not.

> do you think it's okay to not use a ReplayPlayer in test scenes that request autoplay..?

I mean not really because this way we can't pause in tests. But I really just want to get this PR over so, sure that's fine.
A workaround for tests is to set the playback speed in the visual test browser to 0% (That's what I've been using until this PR, for skin editor or otherwise).

Crashes when entering results screen with autoplay (disco prince / osu!):
```
[runtime] 2021-06-02 02:19:45 [error]: at osu.Game.Screens.Ranking.SoloResultsScreen.FetchScores(Action`1 scoresCallback) in /home/smgi/Repos/osu/osu.Game/Screens/Ranking/SoloResultsScreen.cs:line 30
[runtime] 2021-06-02 02:19:45 [error]: at osu.Game.Screens.Ranking.ResultsScreen.LoadComplete() in /home/smgi/Repos/osu/osu.Game/Screens/Ranking/ResultsScreen.cs:line 197
[runtime] 2021-06-02 02:19:45 [error]: at osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.loadComplete()
[runtime] 2021-06-02 02:19:45 [error]: at osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.UpdateSubTree()
```

> Crashes when entering results screen with autoplay (disco prince / osu!):

Need a bit more investigation as to how to resolve this one. For now I've updated the autoplay tests to actually fail.
Let me double-check on the second test failure here... might be related?
Maybe, I think I can repro the test failure in-game on master though. Try to watch a replay after completing a map.
Nah, definitely failing more on this branch. Will take a look.

**Describe the bug:**
When you enable autoplay mod in solo mode(screen) and play it, it changes to the SoloPlayer screen instead of the ReplayPlayer screen.
AT mod could proceed with the solo score submission for this issue. 
(Currently, osu-web doesn't allow "AT" mods as `invalid mod for ruleset: "AT"`)

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/37479424/116805022-61bd3f00-ab5e-11eb-87e4-80c9868ff87c.mp4

(there is solo score submission request on logs)

**osu!lazer version:** local debug based on https://github.com/ppy/osu/commit/05e18e3ee3f7cd142162c06c47b9fdb11ee094ac

comments: That also means users can't pause/resume the gameplay clock in autoplay, as it's a `ReplayPlayer`-only feature.

I'm planning on looking into this, but not too sure on the correct path to take.

Currently, `ReplayPlayer` takes a score as a `ctor` argument, which makes sense for watching a replay, but not for autoplay.

My plan of attack was to move this to `Player`, passing in the replay score in `Player`'s `ctor` (as an optional parameter). But on further investigation, there is already a `CreateScore()` function which is run on player completion (in the base `Player` implementation).

Do you think we should change the whole flow so that function is called much earlier in the process (ie. in the `ctor`), rather than on completion? And if we still need population to occur on completion that can be a new function called `ApplyToScore` or something?

So then `ReplayPlayer` would be constructed without a replay and would create the replay + score internally? That sounds backwards to me, because I imagine `SongSelect` instead creating the autoplay and then constructing a `ReplayPlayer` with it.

One of the big sticking problems to all of this is that `ModAutoplay` attaches the replay directly to the `DrawableRuleset`...

If we're moving the generation of autoplay to a higher level, how do you see the playable beatmap construction happening? Do you think it's okay to call that stuff a second time before `Player` loads?
No, I don't think it's okay. Unless there's caching and loading at a higher level. We're already loading too many beatmaps.

review_comments: I meant... This entire override doesn't need to exist anymore, does it? And the one in SpectatorPlayer.
Ah. So you're saying we should allow the re-recording of frames to the score target..? I'm not sure if that will work but can try if that's your intention here.

OH it's a completely different method call!
```
SetReplayScore(Score)
SetRecordTarget(Score)
```
\>_<
I'm wondering if the naming should be changed, or if the method is combined with a `bool shouldRecord`. Not sure..
Not sure if there's a better location or way of doing this?
